remarks: Located in the gated community of San Juan Hills, with sweeping views of the 15th fairway and Lake, this "Masters" home offers 4 Bedrooms plus Oversized added Loft. Walking into the private wrap around patio area, you'll find beautiful modern glass doors, durable pebble tech surfaces, and a wonderful Pool for enjoying the outdoors. Inside you're greeted with luxury vinyl floors taking you through the light, bright open living spaces. Kitchen is remodeled and features granite counters, spacious island, pull out drawers, and updated Stainless steel appliances - which are included with the sale!
